exposure: Early-onset invasive Group B Streptococcal disease (EoD)
Late-onset invasive Group B Streptococcal disease (LoD)
cohort: The study included 35 newborns at Groote Schuur Hospital with blood or cerebrospinal fluid-positive cases of invasive Group B Streptococcal disease between January 2015 and December 2020.
finding: Invasive GBS disease in newborns at Groote Schuur Hospital is associated with a high overall mortality rate of 23%, with similar mortality rates observed between early-onset (22%) and late-onset (24%) disease groups.
birth_weight: Median birth weight was 900 g for the LoD group and 1 812 g for the EoD group.
gest_age: Median gestational age at birth was 27 weeks for the LoD group and 31.5 weeks for the EoD group.
